description: Get a reference exchange rate, not a converted amount: supply base_currency and quote_currency as three-letter ISO codes supported by ECB via Frankfurter. Returns rate, published rate date and provider_code; retrieved_at is fetch time, not rate time. Latest available daily reference data, not a real-time trading feed or executable quote. Price: $0.0010 production USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Example arguments: {"base_currency":"GBP","quote_currency":"USD"}.
name: get_fx_rate
